fw_update_desc: Pick a nucleoos.bin and install it wirelessly — no USB cable. The image is written to the spare flash slot and only booted if it is valid; if the new firmware fails to start, the device automatically rolls back to this one. So it always stays bootable.
keep_powered: ⚠ Keep the device powered during the update. It reboots automatically when done.
app_shell_desc: The shell and apps live on the SD card, so they update independently of the firmware — either by syncing the card from a PC (deploy.ps1 -To <sd>) or over the network with npm run push-ota -- --host http://<ip>. After a web update, just reload the shell.
image_written: Image written. Rebooting into the new firmware…
update_complete: Update complete — device is back online. ✔
confirming: The new firmware has started: checking it stays stable before it is confirmed…
rolled_back: The new firmware did not stay stable: the device went back to the previous version on its own. No data was touched.
reboot_timeout: Device did not come back in time. Check it and refresh.
err_empty: This file is empty — pick the nucleoos.bin firmware image.
err_not_image: This is not an ESP32 firmware image (maybe a saved web page or a broken download).
err_merged: This is the full-flash image (nucleoos-latest.bin, with bootloader) — for USB flashing only. Pick the OTA image (…-ota.bin / nucleoos.bin).
err_too_big: This file is larger than the firmware slot ({max}) — it is not a NucleoOS OTA image.
err_busy: the device is busy with another download — try again in a moment
err_pending: The device is still confirming the previous update: retry in a few seconds.
err_layout: Unrecognised memory layout: update over USB (web flasher).
not_applied: The connection was lost and the device did not restart — the update was NOT installed. Try again.
confirm_install: Install {v}? The system will be modified; the installer takes a backup you can return to.
confirm_rollback: Restore the state from {s}? System files go back to how they were before that install.
no_backups: No backups yet: one is made on every install.
job_partial: installed IN PART ({what}): try again, or roll back {s} below
no_packages: No packages. Looked in: {dirs}. A package is produced on the console with nucleos-harvest.sh then nucleos-pack.sh, or you copy a release .tar.gz into one of those folders.
ota_unavailable: Updates are not available on this device.
